_comment: Operator repo (cogni-dao/cogni) ONLY: the COMPLETE required-status-checks set for `main`, including the
Node repos MUST NOT use this file: they cannot request a review yet (task.5448), and node protection is
owned by the node template policy (.cogni/repo-policy.json).
Existing contexts keep today's semantics: `app_id: -1` is GitHub's explicit 'any source' (what the
`contexts` form of branch-protection.json stores as app_id null). `Cogni Git PR Review` is pinned to the
review App, id 2994706 (app `cogni-operator`, the writer of that check on PR #3066). It reports on the merge
queue commit through the operator webhook, which copies the PR head's verdict there (task.5438).
Why a separate file: setup-main-branch.sh and branch-protection.json stay the node-shape canonical set
(they PUT the four generic contexts). This file is the operator's superset and is applied by a human admin.
ORDER: deploy the webhook queue copy and see `feature.review_queue_verdict.complete` in Loki BEFORE applying,
or every queued PR waits the 60 min queue response timeout and is ejected. Re-apply after any run of
setup-main-branch.sh on this repo, because that script PUTs the four generic contexts only.
jq 'with_entries(select(.key | startswith("_") | not))' infra/github/branch-protection.operator.json | gh api -X PATCH repos/cogni-dao/cogni/branches/main/protection/required_status_checks --input -
Rollback: PUT the node-shape set again with `bash infra/github/setup-main-branch.sh cogni-dao/cogni`.
